headline: Sammaan Capital certifies timely interest payment on listed secured debentures
sum: Sammaan Capital Limited filed a Regulation 57 certification with NSE confirming timely interest payment on its publicly-issued secured redeemable non-convertible debentures. The filing confirms regulatory compliance under SEBI LODR 2015.
detail: Sammaan Capital Limited notified the NSE (via Form Intimation dated 7 August 2026) that it has made full and timely payment of interest on secured redeemable non-convertible debentures issued through public offer and listed on stock exchanges. This certification is required under SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015, Regulation 57, which mandates listed debt issuers to disclose material events including interest/principal payment milestones. The filing demonstrates the company's debt servicing capacity and continuing covenant compliance.
